data.name: Heat: Pedal to the Metal
data.detailed_description:
Heat: Pedal to the Metal is the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game from Days of Wonder, authored by Asger Harding Granerud & Daniel Skjold Pedersen, bringing its thrilling card-driven racing to life for 1-12 players in the golden age of 1960s motorsport.

The roar of the engine. The pressure of every corner. The split-second decision between playing it safe or pushing your car beyond its limits.

Step into the cockpit of a 1960s racing driver and battle for every position across iconic circuits. Each turn, you'll strategically play cards to control your speed, navigate tight corners and push your engine to the limit. Every card is a risk-reward decision: brake at the right moment, conserve your engine, or risk overheating it for the perfect overtake. As the race unfolds, it becomes a tense contest of nerve and timing where knowing when to hold back and when to take a risk can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

Race across four iconic circuits, challenge Legends, compete with friends locally or online and enjoy a wide variety of race experiences with championship mode, sponsorships, garage upgrades, weather conditions and road conditions. No two races unfold the same way, rewarding clever planning, calculated risks and perfect timing.

FEATURES

  • 3D recreations of four iconic circuits: USA, France, Great Britain, and Italy

  • Challenge Legends in solo play or race against friends in local custom games

  • Play championships with garage upgrades, sponsorships, weather, and road conditions

  • Cross-platform online multiplayer with private lobbies and matchmaking

  • The Legends expansion INCLUDED for free from day one!

  • More official expansions coming post-launch

data.short_description: Play your cards strategically and push your engine to the limit in Heat: Pedal to the Metal, the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Manage your speed, master every corner and race through the golden age of 1960s motorsport against friends, Legends and players worldwide.
data.reviews:
“Heat: Pedal to the Metal is a tabletop racing masterpiece”
Polygon

“Heat might be the best racing board game ever designed”
9/10 – IGN

“I love racing games. One comes along that looks this good, that works this well, that puts you in the driver's seat in such an interesting, engaging, visceral kind of way, it's gonna get a big thumbs up!”
9/10 – The Dice Tower

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 / Intel HD Graphics 530 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 or equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
